author: Shu local scene lighting adaptation
implementation: Godot 4.7.2 built-in Compatibility directional lighting and PCF shadows; original authored light profiles and UI only
notes: Original profile values remain unchanged. Enhanced profile uses a less saturated warm sun (#fff2df/.80), cool ambient (#bccbd0/.28) and fill (#b5cad8/.09).
The same lights shade approved actors, refined original procedural enemies and scenery. All model and imported texture payloads remain unchanged.
The stage adds Compatibility depth fog from 24 to 54 metres, sky contribution zero, to soften distant ridges. This is ordinary distance fog, not volumetric fog.
SSAO and global Glow remain disabled; no LightmapGI, built-in DOF or renderer change.
Attack choreography, local camera focus and UI layout are presentation only, preserving rules and host settlement.
prior_slice_notes: Original profile reproduces 18822 light, environment and shadow settings; the extra fill is hidden.
Both combat actors and scenery share the same world lights, without changing any model or material payload.

Simplified SSAO was evaluated at 0.10/0.65 and 0.035/0.28 radius/intensity. Actual orthographic scene captures show visible false creases on layered distant mountains, so SSAO is disabled in both shipped profiles.
No PCSS, SSIL, volumetric fog or LightmapGI was introduced. Shadow bias is tuned for contact; shadow distance does not tighten the shadow frustum of this orthographic camera.
The comparison changes presentation only, without modifying gameplay, saves or the environment clock.
